build_aligner_config: build a UnitY2ForcedAlignerConfig dataclass with nar_model_ckpt, m4t dict paths, and speech tokenizer settings
create_forced_aligner: create a UnitY2ForcedAligner instance from a config to project character timestamps into words
run_process_utterance: run process_utterance on a waveform and text to get a prosodically annotated Utterance with word-level timestamps
review_process_utterance_chinese: review process_utterance to handle Chinese text by removing punctuation and introducing spaces for alignment
test_get_word_tokenizer: test the get_word_tokenizer method to initialize and cache a word tokenizer for a given language
